Styleguide.title: Design system
Styleguide.lead: Tokens, typography and core components. This page is not indexed and is disabled in production.
Styleguide.sampleHeading: Consistency, discretion and care in every detail
Styleguide.sampleBody: Body text uses a clean sans-serif at a comfortable reading size. Headings use an elegant serif. Layouts tolerate text 30–40% longer than English.

Consent.title: Your privacy
Consent.body: We would like to measure visits anonymously to improve this website. It uses no cookies and no personal data, but we only load it with your agreement. Essential storage is always on. <link>Cookie policy</link>
